x: The Nagoya Protocol was adopted at COP10, Nagoya, in 2010 and entered into force in 2014. The other pairs are wrong: the Cartagena Protocol was adopted in 2000 and in force in 2003 (not 2010/2014), the KMGBF was adopted in 2022 (not 2000), and the Aichi Targets were adopted in 2010 for 2011-2020 (not 2022 for 2030-2050).

The BBNJ Agreement (High Seas Treaty) concerns marine biodiversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction, i.e. the high seas. It entered into force on 17 January 2026; India signed it in September 2024. Wetlands (Ramsar), national parks and GM-crop biosafety (Cartagena) are covered by other instruments.
Under the Kigali Amendment to the Montreal Protocol, India's HFC freeze year is 2028.
